responses.demo_ai_experience: I use Codex, Claude Code, and spend $415 a month (right now) for frontier AI subscriptions. All of what I do is AI. Annotation and my own work, running a business as an AI Automation specialist. I am dictating about 100k words a week so far with AI, all day, every day, frequently approaching usage limits, but not really hitting them anymore. From apps to agents to websites and workflows, I'm building seemingly everything at once.
